brief: Saudi Arabia: Al Shubaily Grand Mall in Al Khobar began a phased soft opening on 29 Oct, with cinemas, go-karts and three retail and dining zones, and plans its grand opening for 2027; the directory still lists it as the upcoming Al Shubily Mall.

Retail costs: Abdullah Al Othaim Markets told Tadawul the 2027 utility tariffs will add about 0.5% of revenue to its annual costs from Q1 2027, the first company figure on the change, and Nahdi Medical cut its 2026 profit forecast, citing geopolitical pressures.
Members: LuLu signed for a 210,000 sq ft hypermarket in Maqam Holding's planned housing and retail project in Al Shahama, Abu Dhabi, due by UAE National Day 2027 (28 Oct).
AI agents: Home Depot will admit AI shopping agents that identify themselves and the customer they act for, and is in talks with Meta on how Muse should introduce itself.

2027 Directory: Friday's check found City Mall - Khafji trading as Al Othaim Mall Khafji and Eko Atlantic Mall still unbuilt, with 107,500 sqm of net leasable area published; 14 of the 16 old pipeline listings checked could not be confirmed from owners' sources.
weekly_brief: Week 44 (26 to 30 October): 31 findings and 8 library documents across five editions, and the third Friday check of directory listings (16 listings).

Openings and tenants: Al Shubaily Grand Mall in Al Khobar began a phased soft opening on 29 Oct; Pacsun opened its first store outside the UAE at Assima Mall in Kuwait; ABYAT's first Qatar store at Mall of Qatar opens soon; TimeVallée opened a luxury watch boutique at GTC Mall, Nairobi; and LuLu opened a LuLu Daily in Zayed City and signed for a 210,000 sq ft hypermarket in Al Shahama.

Members: Aldar's Q3 revenue rose 16% to Dh9.3bn while development sales fell 34%; Cenomi signed a SAR 104.3m facilities management contract for Westfield Jeddah from Q4 2026; Knowledge Economic City votes on 15 Nov on becoming Al-Jiwar Economic City; and Seef Properties added AI avatars and voice service in its Bahrain malls.

Saudi rules and costs: the Cabinet approved a 271-article Commercial Transactions Law on 27 Oct; electricity and water tariffs change on 1 Jan 2027, which Al Othaim Markets puts at about 0.5% of its revenue a year; the Nitaqat pay threshold for Saudi staff rises; and Nahdi Medical cut its 2026 profit forecast.

Türkiye, Central Asia and the Caucasus: Konyaspor plans the club-owned Cadde 42 mall in Konya; Van Mall AVM units go to tender on 2 Nov; İnegöl AVM won silver and bronze at the Solal Awards 2026; TEDİ opened at V Metroway AVM; Bishkek's new Madina market passed to state ownership; and Derimod runs four stores in Baku malls.

AI agents: retailers are choosing between blocking and admitting them: BCG finds 42% of large retailers open to any agent, Home Depot will admit agents that identify themselves, Meta launched Muse in Singapore and US banks are restricting third-party agents; in the region, Dubai Chambers launched a 22-agent marketplace and the open Jais 3 models transcribe Arabic dialects from 19 countries.

2027 Directory: sheet 10 gained Cadde 42 and the Al Shahama project (Watch) and Van Mall AVM, GTC Mall Nairobi, City Park Mall Baku, Aviation Plaza and the new Madina market (Check first); Friday's check found City Mall - Khafji trading as Al Othaim Mall Khafji and Eko Atlantic Mall still unbuilt, while 14 of 16 old pipeline listings could not be confirmed from owners' sources.

findings.title: Al Shubaily Grand Mall in Al Khobar begins a phased soft opening, with the grand opening planned for 2027
findings.summary: Arabian AlEsaar says Al Shubaily Grand Mall in Al Khobar began a phased soft opening on 29 Oct 2026 at 4pm, with stores and facilities opening in stages and the grand opening planned for 2027. The leisure offer includes cinemas (operator not named), go-kart tracks, children's play areas and arcade games, alongside three zones: De L'Avenue for fashion and luxury, The Valley for international dining and The Promenade, facing the waterfront. The release gives no GLA, store count or brand names and calls the mall the largest of its kind in the region, a claim it does not support with figures.
findings.why: A leisure-led mall is opening in the Eastern Province alongside The Avenues Khobar and Westfield Dammam, and the directory still prints it as upcoming under a different spelling.

sources.outlet: Arabian AlEsaar press release (ACCESS Newswire, via FinancialContent)

findings.title: Al Othaim Markets says the 2027 utility tariffs will add about 0.5% of revenue to its annual costs
findings.summary: Abdullah Al Othaim Markets told Tadawul that the electricity, water and sewage tariff changes taking effect on 1 Jan 2027 will raise its annual operating costs by about 0.5% of consolidated revenue, with the effect showing from Q1 2027, and that it is cutting energy use and improving efficiency to offset the rise (Argaam, 29 Oct). SASCO told Tadawul the same day that its operating costs will rise from 1 Jan 2027, without a figure.
findings.why: It is the first company figure on what the 2027 Saudi utility tariffs will cost a large retailer, a cost line mall owners and their tenants will also carry.

findings.title: Nahdi Medical now expects its 2026 profit to fall, citing geopolitical pressures
findings.summary: Nahdi Medical's management said on its Q3 2026 earnings call that it has lowered its full-year 2026 net profit forecast and now expects a year-on-year decline, Argaam reported on 29 Oct, attributing the cut to ongoing geopolitical pressures. The size of the revision and the Q3 figures are behind Argaam's paywall and are not reported here.
findings.why: A profit warning from one of Saudi Arabia's largest pharmacy chains is an early read on how the regional security situation is weighing on Saudi retail trading.

findings.title: Home Depot will admit AI shopping agents that identify themselves and the customer they act for
findings.summary: Home Depot will support AI agents that search, compare and buy for customers, provided they identify themselves as agents and confirm whom they represent, so the retailer keeps contact with the shopper, chief information officer Angie Brown told Business Insider, as reported by PYMNTS on 29 Oct. The company is in talks with Meta on how its Muse agent should introduce itself; the draft Personal Agent Protocol from Meta and Sierra, which Walmart, Shopify and Stripe are helping develop, does not yet cover payments.
findings.why: A second large US retailer is choosing identity rules over blocking, the choice GCC retailers, mall apps and banks face as agents such as Muse reach new markets.
